evidence: Carries the Validation label and directly alters block index state maintenance, pruning handling in blockstorage, and setBlockIndexCandidates mutation.
rationale: Resolves block index inconsistency, crashes under CheckBlockIndex, and multiset ordering corruption in candidate selection.
